Subject: Preflight: executive intro + consolidated demo window request

Hi Andrea / Tyler —

Thanks again for the time last week. We27d like to propose a short exec-intro + demo for StratusSys to walk through the production profile and how Redwood would fit into your infra constraints. Specifically we27re hoping to get a CIO-level presence for a short Q&A and the VP of Engineering or their delegate for decisioning items.

Two consolidated windows that work on our side:
- Tue Aug 24: 09:00-11:00 PT (we can take a 45-60m slot anywhere in that range)
- Wed Aug 25: 13:00-15:00 PT (preferred for engineering attendees)

If neither fits, we can compress to a 30-45m focused briefing and technical highlight — let us know priority (CIO vs VP) and preferred slot. I27ve attached a short sponsor agenda and the deck we27d show.

Next steps: if you can flag the preferred window and confirm who will be the primary exec, we27ll lock the invite and share a 10-point prep note for the CIO.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0143

Attachment: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf (slide deck stub)

Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preflight: executive intro + consolidated demo window request

Thanks Michael — appreciate the clear options. Quick answers from our side:

- CIO (Ruth Chen) can join Wed Aug 25 at 13:00 PT but would need the session to be 45 minutes max (she has an executive block afterwards).
- VP of Engineering (Marcus Lee) is traveling Aug 24 and prefers Aug 26 early morning PT, so not ideal. He suggested I see if we can compress to Aug 25 and he will dial in for the first 20 minutes if needed.

Two asks from us:
1) Can Redwood compress the agenda to a 45-minute slot centered on exec value and a single technical highlight (35m presentation + 10m for Q&A)?
2) Please include a backup internal contact who can pick up procurement/contract questions if Marcus can27t stay the whole time.

If that works, we27ll hold Wed Aug 25 13:00-13:45 PT and I27ll confirm Ruth and try to get Marcus on for the first 20.

Andrea
Andrea Morales
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts — StratusSys
andrea.morales@stratussys.com | +1 971-555-0202

Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preflight: executive intro + consolidated demo window request

Michael / Lauren —

Looping in a quick internal plan while Andrea locks exec attendance:
- We can absolutely compress to a 45m briefing. Proposed split: 20m exec value + 20m technical highlight (latency/cost profile + a two-slide ops playbook) + 5-10m QA.
- Michael: you lead the exec value and close.
- Lauren: can you own procurement/readout and be the backup for contract-level Qs (T&Cs, data residency, SLA ask)?
- I27ll own the engineering follow-ups and take notes + next-step items in HubSpot (deal RDW-4531).

If Marcus can only be there for the first 20, we27ll make sure the technical highlight starts at minute 18 so he hears the critical bit. Also propose we attach a one-page follow-up that maps our quantization/latency tradeoffs to StratusSys27s expected throughput — I27ll draft that after the call.

Ben

Andrea / Tyler —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Wed Aug 25 13:00-13:45 PT is confirmed on our side and we27ll compress the agenda as requested: 20m exec value (I27ll open), 20m engineering highlight (Ben will run the deep technical bit), 5m Q&A. Lauren will be the procurement backup for contract/terms questions.

I27ve attached the updated sponsor agenda and the deck; I27ll send a calendar invite with the 45m block and the GoTo meeting link. After the session Ben will follow up with a one-page mapping doc and a short mutual action plan with next steps.

Two quick items for Andrea: please confirm Ruth Chen (CIO) as primary attendee and whether Marcus Lee (VP Eng) will dial in for the first 20 minutes. That will help us decide whether to front-load the single technical slide for Marcus.

Will send the invite now. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Michael Grant
